mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is non-negative (>=0) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.6% indicates a tight labor market, which may lead to inflationary pressures and aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.6%.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 650,000 million dollars and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102, it signals a demand surge without sufficient supply, leading to inflation and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 650000 and INDPRO < 102.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 2.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during the monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 295 indicates high inflation, which triggers central bank rate hikes and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank correlation between HOUST and 60-day SPX returns is non-positive (<=0) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units, it signals a sectoral shift from manufacturing to construction, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 102 and HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A PAYEMS level above 150,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.
